body:
maria: Heads-up: private installer bundle needs an 'evacuation' delivery window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Packaging hits airgap staging and we need signer/KMS handoff before transit.
packager: Working on bundle now. Will push sub-manifest + checksums to staging-bucket. ETA 45m.
devops-bot: Upload started: bundle-v2.3.1.tar.gz -> s3://private-bundles/staging/1725601111/ (obj 128MB).
packager: Checksum: sha256:abc123def4567890... I'll paste full in a sec. Also pinning images to shrinkwrap tag `v2.3.1-shrink` to avoid drift.
josh: Can we hold cutover until signer confirms? Last time auto-sign caused mismatch.
signer-bot: Waiting for manifest object. Run: `cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/delivery-key manifest.json`
signe: I can rotate the delivery key after handoff. Need 15m to run rotation post-delivery for audit.
lee: Ops window approved 03:00-04:30 UTC. If any rollback needed, we'll revert to tag `v2.3.0-lock` and unpublish the new manifest.
packager: Pushed manifest and checksum: manifest.json, sha256:abc123def4567890... link: https://internal.s3/staging/manifest.json
devops-bot: Signer request queued. cosign request id: q9f3. ETA 5m.
signer-bot: cosign sig created: sigs/manifest.sig (key id deliv-2024).
maria: once signed, @release-coordinator will trigger the transport handover to carrier with signed manifest and checksum. Please attach release-notes small bullet list.
release-coordinator: I'll publish release notes to the private portal and include migration steps. Draft copy: '- pin images, - validate sha256, - restart installers w/ KMS auth' Ready to post after sign.
josh: If we see >1% checksum mismatch rate during staging validation, kill transport and roll back. Who will run validation?
lee: I'll coordinate validation. Use `rci-validate --manifest manifest.json --bucket staging` and report within 20m of handoff.
packager: Running validation now against local mirror. Results: 0 mismatches. Attaching sample logs:
``nvalidation: ok 100/100 files
retries: 0
```
Proceeding to sign.
signer-bot: signed ok. signature: deliv-2024:SIGXYZ
maria: @release-coordinator go/no-go?
release-coordinator: GO. Starting transport handoff at 03:05 UTC. Notifying customer ops. :rocket: 
josh: Tagging for rollback plan: `v2.3.1-shrink` -> deployed, rollback -> `v2.3.0-lock`. Documented.
signe: I'll run key rotation after we confirm delivery complete. leaving 15m buffer.
lee: Logging post-delivery check at 04:00 UTC. If any checksum fails, we'll initiate rollback window (04:00-04:30).
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes with final hash + signer id.
devops-bot: handoff event recorded: handoff-id 202403-1725601111-1
release-coordinator: :thumbsup: closing loop. Will post after-ops summary.
